title: Verify: BootScene effect wiring and Phaser context unit tests
summary: Mocked Phaser tests for effect context and BootScene
acceptance_criteria: BootScene wiring and shutdown cleanup are asserted
Phaser context fade and ambient light creation are asserted

steps.action: vi.mock('phaser') as in bootScene.test.ts and vi.mock('@game/engine/buildEffects') returning handles with destroy vi.fn(); create BootScene, call create(); assert buildEffects called with the scene from ../src/runtime/content; capture the SHUTDOWN callback passed to events.once and invoke it; assert each handle destroy called
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts

steps.action: Call createPhaserEffectContext with a fake scene {cameras:{main:{fadeIn:vi.fn()}},add:{rectangle,particles}} and assert playTransition(400) calls fadeIn(400) and createEffect for ambientLight calls add.rectangle with depth set
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts -t playTransition
